item.title: ggml's First 1.0: The Deprecated APIs Are Gone, and RPC v9 Refuses Incompatible Peers
item.description: ggml, the tensor library under llama.cpp, ships its first 1.0: deprecated API removed, RPC protocol bumped to v9 which refuses incompatible peers, FP8 support lands. Clean-build median on a 2-core EPYC slice: 102.3s. Full post and discussion live on the BBS.

item.title: Your 32G One-Card AutoDL Box + Existing C++ llama.cpp Can Deploy DSpark: One Command, a 1.5G Sidecar
item.description: A 32G AutoDL host that only has C++ llama.cpp: skip vLLM, skip Python. llama.cpp now carries DSpark speculative decoding natively (PR #25173) - attach a 1.5G Q8 sidecar and one flag turns it on. DSpark bets deeper than the built-in MTP, so it is fastest on short code and short QA. FP16 full-precision 54G will not fit one card, run Q4.

item.title: llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang: Three Inference Engines, Three Completely Different Paths
item.description: llama.cpp, vLLM, and SGLang aren't competitors in the same lane — they're built on entirely different design assumptions. Which one fits your workload? The answer depends on one metric you probably haven't measured.

item.title: Bring Kimi K2 Thinking Home with 247GB RAM: Dynamic 1-bit GGUF Field Notes
item.description: Step-by-step guide to running Unsloth's Dynamic 1-bit GGUF build of the 1T-parameter Kimi K2 Thinking model on high-end PCs, covering install, download, inference, serving, and troubleshooting.
